stage(r1b-r2b): preserve upstream interruption-recovery evidence for Case C

R1B_R2B_INTERRUPTION_RECOVERY.zip independently corroborates the Case C
determination this stage was rebuilt under. Its sweep targeted d60c7f7 and
47df6c5d and returned candidate_count 0, candidates [], selected_repo null,
with an empty command set because no workspace was found. Two independent
searches — this session's across rei_bianchi, rec_bianchi, htt_base, the
reflog, all remote refs and the filesystem, and the upstream sweep — agree the
d60c7f7 workspace does not exist, so refusing to inherit it no longer rests on
this session's word alone.

The same evidence establishes that no competing upstream R1B-R2B implementation
exists: the upstream run was interrupted before producing one, main carries no
R1B-R2B stage directory, and no other remote branch holds one. This branch
merges into origin/main with no conflict; merge-base equals origin/main and
merge-tree is clean.

The archive is preserved verbatim under receipts/upstream_interruption_recovery
with both payload files verifying against the shipped SHA256SUMS. Archive
SHA-256 98ca13d62b98fe62e234c284b3e01c5c73ca8903c18485037d8362916ec4f1ca.

INPUT_LOCK.json is deliberately left untouched. The lock was sealed before
calculation, and amending it afterwards to cite supporting evidence would break
the discipline that makes a precalculation lock meaningful, so the corroboration
is recorded in receipts instead.
